scenes.prompt: Use case: game-scene-background. Create an original BACKGROUND PLATE for our portrait sci-fi mobile game. Image 1 shows this specific scene's existing purpose and broad spatial composition. Image 2 is the recently revised workshop, the practical material, architectural scale and detail-density reference for our project. Image 3 is a scene from our own PSD and supplies the project palette and soft depth treatment. Make a believable space with a distinct floor, rear wall and large structural frames; preserve mid-sized forms and gentle reflections so it feels like a place, while simplifying tiny mechanical details, dense racks and distracting floor grids. Match cool silver/slate-blue steel, natural sky light, subtle cyan accents, and occasional warm practical lights; soften distant detail without making a uniformly blurred blank wall. The main character or object, its platform, controls and labels are rendered separately; the middle must remain calm and readable with no background object that clashes. Do not include any person, pilot, robot, aircraft, weapons, vehicle, UI, text, numbers, logo, watermark, border or icon. Do not paint diagonal scanlines; our original PSD texture is overlaid separately in the game. Scene: aircraft display and launch hangar. Keep an open view of the sky at the left edge, a large hangar structural arch, and a recognizable broad floor extending behind an independently rendered 3D aircraft and its existing separate pedestal. Include only a few large wall recesses, avoid crates and a second pedestal. Square composition with important structures visible inside a centered 0.9:1 crop. The center behind the aircraft should be a dark-to-mid steel-blue value, so a white aircraft reads clearly.
